Pricing

Pricing

Every case is different, so we do not publish a single headline price. Here is exactly how fees are set.

Engagement models

Case review

A fixed fee for a written diagnosis of your notice, root cause and options. Credited toward the next stage if you continue with us.

Appeal or Plan of Action package

A fixed fee for evidence preparation, the written submission and follow-up drafts on the same decision.

Held funds support

A fixed fee for hold classification, evidence and release request drafting.

Priority handling

A fixed supplement where a notice deadline or stopped revenue needs same-day work.

Monitoring and audits

A monthly or per-audit fee for accounts that need an experienced eye after reinstatement.

Pricing principles

  • Full scope and a fixed fee confirmed in writing before any paid work starts
  • No hidden fees and no open-ended hourly billing
  • No success fees contingent on a platform decision we do not control
  • If we think the case is weak, we tell you before you pay for an appeal

Start with the notice.

Send us what the platform sent you. We reply in writing with what we see, what we would do, and whether we think the case is worth pursuing.
